dedupe_keys.name: ghana statistical service 2021 population and housing census 10 percent microdata housing and sanitation file

description: The Ghana Statistical Service distributes a 10 percent sample of the 2021 Population and Housing Census through its NADA microdata catalogue as a public use dataset. The housing and sanitation file holds 1,007,074 household records with 99 variables from the housing module of the main questionnaire: dwelling unit characteristics, ownership of household assets, type of toilet facility and methods of liquid and solid waste disposal, with weights for housing and population estimates. Companion files cover the de facto population (3,084,983 records, 242 variables), absentees, emigrants and mortality. Coverage is national, with region and district identifiers, for everyone in Ghana on census night, 27 June 2021. Format and access: data files after free registration and login, DDI XML and PDF documentation open to all. Licence: public use terms that allow statistical and research use only and forbid redistribution without written agreement. Caveats: a sample, not the full count; the GSS census report list names volumes on housing characteristics, water and sanitation, ICT and structures, but their file links were placeholders and the census 2021 microsite reset the connection from the cloud. Simulation uses: district level sanitation, waste and housing conditions for service planning and exposure models. Related records: the Meta electrical distribution grid maps for Africa and the Côte d'Ivoire RGPH 2021 household counts.
